Thm 3: nerve of a category is 2-coskeletal -- objects=N_0, arrows=N_1, src/tgt/id = face/degeneracy, composition = d_1:N_2->N_1 all live in tr_2, and iso of tr_2 nerves = iso of categories. Hence F_2 = F_3 = ... = all iso-invariants: NO strict third TRUNCATION rung for fixed-category invariants. Reconciliation: truncation level of H^n = min(n+1,2) (collapses) vs cocycle-condition level = n+1 (never collapses); old '2' conflated them.

Thm 4 (elementary): associativity is an N_3 predicate on unital magmoids not expressible on tr_2 data. Witness: unital magma on {1,x,y}, x.x=y, x.y=x, y.x=y, y.y=y; (x.x).x = y.x = y but x.(x.x) = x.y = x, non-assoc at the triple (x,x,x) in N_3 while all N_2 data present and unital. So the genuine strict N_2 < N_3 lives in the assembly problem (vary the composition), where 2-coskeletal collapse does not apply.
